scientific_integrity: Definitions and proof explicitly distinguish hop-total Roman domination from Roman {3}, ordinary total Roman, and 2-hop Roman variants; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All minimizing HTRDFs of Cartesian products K_m square K_n only; no full weight polynomial or products with three factors. Finite computational checks corroborate but do not prove arbitrary sizes. Unindexed equivalent literature is a residual priority risk.
title: All minimum hop total Roman dominating functions of Cartesian rook graphs
